scope: First representative Ready sample for queue.ready, for style review before Working/Retry/Paused family expansion. Candidate work only: no style is approved, and renderer integration of assets/ready.png is outside this sample's acceptance.

contract.intent: Owner requirements: static single-frame 16x16 Ready/success status image, transparent background, readable pixel-art silhouette at 1x and 3x nearest on the #172336 panel, existing cool-blue UI accent, no fixed palette (empty palette), alpha not restricted to binary. Observation: Start SVG accent #70b9ed (color cue, not an exact-color rule). Specialist sample choice: a bare checkmark motif without badge/circle, prompt-only (no style reference exists and the discovered tool has no image input).

criteria.check: Decoded candidate PNG is exactly 16x16 pixels and a single static frame.
criteria.basis: Owner/consumer requirement: 16x16 logical cells; Ready is static; consumer declares frames: 1.

sources.locator: Status cells are 16 by 16 logical pixels; Ready and Retry are static images

criteria.check: Background area is fully transparent with no opaque matte or filled backdrop; partial alpha is permitted (no binary-alpha rule).
criteria.basis: Owner requirement: transparent backgrounds. Binary alpha is not required by any source.
criteria.scope: This candidate file's alpha channel outside the subject.

criteria.check: Viewed at 1x and 3x nearest-neighbor over #172336, the subject is a readable pixel-art silhouette with clean edges (not muddy, noisy or lost against the panel).

criteria.check: The image reads as Ready / successful completion, not as activity/in-progress, failure/retry, or paused.
criteria.basis: Owner/consumer requirement: an ok result becomes succeeded, shown with label Ready; the working loop must not look like success; error/retry and paused must be distinguishable from completion.
criteria.scope: This candidate judged on its own; no other family member exists yet.
